notes: Only the LB agar plate (lawn) samples are in this series; liquid samples are in GSE222248. Lawns plated from a 37 °C culture and incubated at 23 or 37 °C; incubation time on the plate not given. 23 °C treated as cold (summary: 'prolonged cold stress'), exposure adapted since growth on the plate occurred at 23 °C. Oxygen not stated.

culture_mode.q: 200 uL of each sample was plated to make a lawn on an 1.5% LB agar plate that was incubated at 23 or 37°C.

growth_phase.q: 200 uL of each sample was plated to make a lawn on an 1.5% LB agar plate

inducer_added.q: To investigate the effect of growth on LB agar plates and temperature has on the global transcriptomic of E. coli K-12 substr. MG1655.
